text.p: German security systems group Garny AG said on Friday that it expected to report positive results during its 1996/97 business year ending March 31 despite planned comprehensive cost reduction measures.

Garny, whose group net profit for the 1995/96 business year fell to 2.5 million marks from 5.6 million in the prior business year, said sales for the first four months of the current business year were below year ago levels.
But the group said it expected a stabilisation in incoming orders and an increase in sales of its self-serve products.
Garny management board member Albert Grub told the company's annual general meeting that the weakened market situation has not yet turned positive.
